problems.draft_text: - The untyped numerator bounds (27) and (8.1) hold for t ≲ r^(2/3) and fail beyond it.
problems.why: (27) is not an untyped bound. LS-DER-024 says that "the conditional determinant numerator in (4)" is ≤ C_det r⁶. The numerator in (4) is E[W_{r,λ}|det H_y| | pins, f(y)=u, ∇f(y)=0], and §3 says W "retains the exact endpoint type indicators". So (27) is a typed bound. The untyped steps are (26)'s r⁶ ("t^2 per determinant") and (8.1), which bounds |det H_M det H_S det H_y|. For the typed numerator, work/lsder024_advmath/sing_check.log gives typed num/r⁶ at t = r^(2/3) of 7.6e-3, 3.5e-3, 1.7e-3 (θ=π/2) and 2.4e-2, 1.5e-2, 8.4e-3 (θ=π/4) for r = 0.04, 0.02, 0.01: small and falling. So (27) as stated is not shown to fail beyond r^(2/3). Its status is the same as (28)/(8.2), which the rewrite already corrected. The four-lens math check introduced the mislabel ('untyped numerator bounds (27) and (8.1)'), and the rewrite copied it.
problems.replacement: - The untyped product bounds, (26)'s r⁶ on which (27) rests and (8.1), hold for t ≲ r^(2/3) and fail beyond it. (27) itself bounds the typed numerator of (4). Like (28) and (8.2), it is shown to fail only at fixed t and, by power count, for t ≫ r^(1/2).
